decisions.decision: A fire feature at the Teen Center's Polar Plunge in November is acceptable provided the group gets Fire Chief permission.
decisions.quote: k. menard told him as long as they got permission from the fire chief it won't be an issue.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chair asked whether the $100,000 bond figure from the last meeting included prevailing wage; the skate park representative said it did.
budget_items.quote: k. menard asked if the $100,000 amount mentioned at the last meeting took prevailing wage into consideration.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The skate park representative reported contractor estimates for the work, which a Commission member thought sounded low.
budget_items.quote: he had reached out to at least ﬁve contractors who provided estimates ranging from $20,000 to $50,000.

budget_items.topic: Bond split between builder and skate park group
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The skate park representative said the first part of the bonding, which falls to the builder, is around $220,000, and the second part falls to the skate park group.
budget_items.quote: the ﬁrst, around $220,000, would cover the builder and fall to the builder

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Commission member asked where the Town Manager got the figures used to justify the $1.5 million bond amount; the Chair said she researched nearby communities' skate parks.
budget_items.quote: m. mascari asked where the town manager got the ﬁgures used to justify the $1.5 million bond amount.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Facilities Director said a restoration cost is hard to estimate without knowing when in the process restoration may be triggered; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: c. ruth said it's hard to come up with a number for restoration without knowing at what point in the process it may be triggered.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chair cited the Turf Field project, which lacked a completion bond, as a case where the town covered remaining costs after the group ran out of money; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: menard also referenced the turf field project, which lacked a completion bond; when that group ran out of money, the town had to cover the remaining costs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Commission member asked about state earmarks; the skate park representative said none were found. No dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: m. mascari asked if any state earmarks were available. a. caiozzo said they had already explored that option but found none.
